label: Bears on
explanation: Scalia's dissent predicted ossification because a court's Skidmore reading becomes the statute's fixed meaning; after Loper Bright, that independent judicial reading, informed by Skidmore, is the rule for every agency interpretation.

sources.label: United States v. Mead Corp., 533 U.S. 218 (2001), U.S. Reports (PDF, 44 pages)
